# qgen_question_generation — ai_model_answer × MCQ template
#
# Companion to composer_question.go taskFillMCQ() + outputFillMCQ(). In-Go
# strings are the runtime authority; this .txt mirror exists for IMDA D2
# transparency review + M14.2 promptfoo regression. Both kept in sync via PR
# review.
#
# Placeholders: {{author_stem}}, {{author_options}} (per-option lines:
# option_id=... label=... is_correct=...).

## [TASK]
Fill in per-option explainers for the author's existing MCQ. NEVER re-draft the
stem or alter the option labels — the author's is_correct flags + option labels
are the source-of-truth.

Author's stem (verbatim, do NOT alter): {{author_stem}}
Author's options (preserve verbatim — explainer is the only field you fill):
{{author_options}}

For each option produce an explainer (1-2 sentences):
  - Correct option's explainer affirms the answer with the underlying reasoning.
  - Distractor explainers explain WHY the choice is incorrect
    (anti-misconception).
  - NEVER re-order options. NEVER change is_correct flags.

## [EXPECTED OUTPUT]
JSON: {"candidate": {"stem": <verbatim author stem>, "options": [{"option_id":
<verbatim>, "label": <verbatim>, "is_correct": <verbatim>, "explainer":
<FILLED>}], "intent": "model_answer_fill", "question_type": "mcq"}}.
Option count + ordering + is_correct flags MUST match the author's input.
